title: Internal Pricing Simulation Lab & Approval Safeguards
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an internal Pricing Simulation Lab (PSL) and tighten approval safeguards for enterprise contract discounts and SQ-linked concessions. The PSL will let SalesOps + Finance model contract scenarios (volume tiers, multi-year discounts, dedicated capacity add-ons, security questionnaire remediation costs) and produce a recommended pricing guardrail with an auditable approval decision. Deliverables include a runnable simulation notebook + UI, formalized approval steps (who approves what at which discount threshold), automated documentation hooks (sales quote templates and audit logs), and a short runbook for deals engineers and legal reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: PSL can simulate at least 3 contract archetypes (startup PLG, scaled mid-market, enterprise regulated) with inputs for term, seats, dedicated capacity, and SQ remediation hours
Approval matrix implemented in Playbook: discount bands mapped to approvers and review SLAs
Automated audit log created for each simulated quote and final approval decision stored in SalesOps workspace
Playbook and one-page runbook published to Confluence and linked in Salesforce quote flow
Stakeholder sign-off from Finance, Legal, SalesOps, and Security obtained
tasks: Design data model for simulations (price components, cost assumptions, SQ remediation time estimates)
Prototype a Jupyter notebook + sample dataset with canned scenarios
Build lightweight UI mock in Figma for PSL inputs and summary outputs
Define approval thresholds and map approvers to roles (Sales Manager, Head of Revenue, Finance Director)
Integrate audit logging into SalesOps (append simulation snapshot to opportunity record)
Draft Confluence playbook and one-page runbook for deal engineers
Run 5 retrospective simulations with historical closed-won deals to validate model accuracy
